data.one_liner: A Dart bean mapper annotation processor for generating type-safe mappers.
data.what_it_does: Smartstruct is a code generator that creates type-safe bean mappers in Dart, inspired by MapStruct. It automates mapping properties between different model and entity classes.
use_when: You need to map data between models, DTOs, and domain entities
You want compile-time type safety for object-to-object mapping
You prefer annotation-driven code generation over manual mapping
avoid_when: You prefer manual mapping without using build_runner
Your project does not use objects that require mapping between layers
strengths: Supports nested bean mapping, lists, and custom function mappings
Integrates well with build_runner and injectable
weaknesses: Requires running code generation via build_runner
Manual workarounds needed for specific third-party libraries like freezed
data.setup_notes: Add smartstruct to dependencies and smartstruct_generator along with build_runner to dev_dependencies, then run build_runner.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose built_value if you want immutable value classes with built-in serialization and builder patterns.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose freezed if you primarily want union types, pattern matching, and immutable data classes with copyWith.
